8236.overview: You're a high scoring point guard capable of awesome vertical leaps and hangtime. Matter of fact, you can do it all! Dribble. Bouncepass. Fake. Pivot. Jump. Shoot. Play man or zone. Drive the lane and the graphics go MEGA! Is your defender all over you? Give him a move and JAM SLAM IN YOUR FACE! Eight US teams. Play Tournament, League of Exhibition. Lace up those hightops and go for it.

22393.overview: A vertically scrolling helicopter shoot 'em up, Kyukyoku Tiger bears more than a passing resemblance to games like Raiden and Daisenpu. The gameplay is familiar enough, with smart bombs and coloured power-ups that give a variety of weapons.

111197.overview: Kyuukyoku Mahjong is an adult Mahjong game.

111198.overview: Kyuukyoku Mahjong II: Super Idol Graphic is an Adult Mahjong game, which was released in Asia.

121411.overview: Wallaby!! is a racing simulation game from Tenky and Masaya. It plays similarly to a number of horse racing simulators for Japanese systems, but switches the horses for kangaroos and wallabies and human riders for rabbits. The player selects a rabbit as their protagonist and can either raise marsupials for racing or simply bet on those belonging to other rabbits.

203241.overview: Uwol likes money. One day he heard of a cave full of gold coins. Although the cave was guarded by dangerous creatures, Uwol decided not to give up until he will get at least 255 coins.
